findings.text: Provides a variadic device debug reporting routine that accepts a dynamic debug descriptor plus an optional bus device pointer and a message specification, choosing parent aware output when a parent exists, device only output when no parent exists, and an explicit null device report otherwise.
Provides a module parameter callback for dynamic debug queries that records the invoking module and parameter and delegates to shared query dispatch with a not found fallback for unrelated keys.

Provides queue limit management operations to account completions and adapt the limit, to reset all dynamic state to minimum anchored at the current time, and to initialize bounds hold time and stall threshold before reset.

Provides an early archive search routine that scans a memory resident newc archive for a path prefix among regular files and returns a data pointer plus size plus trailing name remainder, or an empty result when not found or malformed.
Boot string setup handler ignores its input and unconditionally reports that it consumed the parameter.

Control write accepts zero length as immediate success without action, rejects inputs at or above the page sized bound with a too big error, copies user input with added termination, executes it as queries, frees the copy, and advances the file offset only when query execution succeeds.

Table iteration starts from the head linked table and walks descriptor indexes downward, advancing to the following table when the current index is exhausted and signalling termination by clearing the table cursor.
Sequence start acquires the global debug mutex, returns a header token for position zero, rejects negative positions, and otherwise skips forward by repeatedly advancing the shared iterator.

Class membership is a half open interval test of an identifier against a map base and length, and class name lookup scans only the maps attached to the current table and yields absence when no map contains the identifier.

Control show emits a fixed header line for the start token and otherwise emits one site line carrying source location, module, function, flags and format, escaping selected whitespace and quote characters, then appends class information only for non default class identifiers with a distinct fallback for unknown identifiers.

Module registration skips descriptor sets with zero sites, allocates a table object, stores caller owned module name and descriptor range, initializes list heads, attaches matching class maps, then appends the table under lock and reports the site count.

Dynamic debug parameter dispatch optionally splits a dotted key into module and leaf, accepts only the dynamic debug leaf with caller supplied fallback otherwise, substitutes a default enable query when no value is present, and reports success even if query execution fails so module loading continues.
Positive difference helper yields zero for non positive signed gaps and the raw gap otherwise, while the ordering helper reports true for zero or positive signed gaps.

Completion accounting forbids completing more than queued minus already completed, derives current and previous backlog and over limit, adapts the limit for starvation or sustained slack with hold time and minimum tracking, clamps to configured bounds, refreshes adjusted limit and previous interval snapshot, then performs stall maintenance.

Reset restores the limit to its minimum, clears queued and completed counts and previous interval and slack state, anchors slack and reap times at now, positions history at the current time slice, and zeroes the history bitmap.

Archive scan requires a minimum header length, skips four byte zero padding, parses fixed width hexadecimal fields with magic field shorter than the rest, validates magic within a two value window, enforces pointer bounds for name and data extents, and matches only regular files whose names carry the requested prefix.

Error name table is indexed by positive error number and stores a dash prefixed symbolic spelling per entry, with conditional entries for architecture specific codes and a compile time guard that the index is positive and bounded.

A single global mutex protects the list of debug tables across sequence traversal and mutation: sequence start acquires it and sequence stop releases it, while module add, module remove and remove all hold it around list linkage changes.

Stall sampling reads shared queue counters and history head with once semantics plus a read barrier paired with the queuing path write barrier, and retries the whole window computation if the head changes during evaluation.

Debug table object carries a module name pointer with distinct lifetime rules for built in versus loadable owners, a descriptor array pointer plus site count, a global list link, and a list of attached class maps.

Traversal cursor carries a current table pointer plus a numeric descriptor index, and a per site descriptor as observed carries filename, line number, function, flags, format, class identifier and module name.

Queue limiter as observed carries current minimum maximum and adjusted limits, queued and completed counts plus previous interval snapshots and last object counts, over limit history, slack minimum start and hold time, and stall threshold count maximum last reap time plus history bitmap and head.

Early archive result carries a data pointer, a size, and a fixed capacity trailing name buffer; the field enumeration orders magic, identity, mode, ownership, link count, time, sizes, device numbers, name size, checksum and a final field count sentinel.

Control interface wiring exposes sequence operations for start next show stop, file operations for open read seek release write, a parallel proc operations vector, and a module notifier block with default priority noting a jump label dependency.

Control listing lifecycle opens private cursor state, then repeats start next show under one held mutex with position zero yielding a header before site entries, and finally releases the mutex on stop.

Module event handling adds a debug table when a module arrives and warns on allocation failure, removes the matching table when a module departs, and converts the handler status through a notifier errno mapping.

Built in initialization scans the linker delimited descriptor range grouping contiguous runs with equal module names into tables, treats an empty range as an error for full builds but as benign success for core builds, marks success, replays the saved command line to apply boot queries including not yet loaded modules, and clears all tables on grouping failure.

Limit adaptation increases the limit when over limit backlog has drained or prior over limit work has fully completed, decreases it only after sustained busy operation with observed slack beyond a hold interval using the minimum slack seen, otherwise retains it, always enforcing configured bounds and resetting the slack window when it changes due to starvation or periodic reduction.

Stall maintenance is inert when the threshold is zero; otherwise when no reap occurred within the threshold it searches a bounded historic window for a queued instant followed by a completion gap, counts one stall with maximum latency on success, and always advances the last reap marker to now.

Control plane is instantiated as a file named control under a dynamic debug directory in debugfs when available and in procfs when directory creation succeeds, using the dedicated open read seek release write vectors.
Boot time query application parses the duplicated saved command line for dynamic debug parameters through a generic argument parser and a dedicated boot callback that forwards to shared dispatch.
Module arrival and departure notifications and load time module parameter queries form the runtime entry points for adding and removing tables and for applying per module queries.
Module removal matches tables by module name pointer identity rather than string contents, so an equal spelling stored at a different address will not be removed and will report not found.
Completion with a count larger than outstanding queued work triggers a fatal bug check, so callers must never report more completions than remain in flight.

Archive lookup warns when the trailing name remainder reaches the fixed name capacity, truncates the stored remainder, still reports the match, and on malformed headers or bounds violations silently returns an empty result with null data and zero size.

Oversize control writes are rejected before any user copy, and user copy or query failures propagate as negative errors without advancing the file offset, so partial application is not signalled as success.
User control input bound is four thousand ninety six bytes including room for termination, so the largest accepted write length is one less.
Control nodes are created with read write owner and read only group and other permissions under a fixed directory and leaf naming in both debug and proc hierarchies.

Archive header length follows eight times the field count minus two, reflecting a six character magic field and eight character remaining fields, and accepted magic values are the base newc value and the next value.
Archive match requires regular file type as determined by masking the mode field, and alignment of name and data extents is to four byte boundaries.

Listing header advertises columns for source path and line, module, function, flags and format, and per site lines carry an assignment marker before flags and quoted format text with optional class suffix.
